title: narcissus bulbocodium subsp. graellsii
intro: Narcissus bulbocodium subsp. graellsii, commonly known as the Spanish bluebell, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Amaryllidaceae family. The Spanish bluebell has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and alleviate stress. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus bulbocodium subsp. graellsii include its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety, and promote a restful sleep. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as narciclasine and haemanthamine, which have been found to exhibit various pharmacological activities.
